source_profile:
Blackvein and Westbridge — Economic conflict, organized crime

Inciting event: A Westbridge merchant consortium secures an enormous shipment of
exceptionally high-quality iron at a fraction of the prevailing market price. Several Blackvein
mining operations lose their purchasing contracts overnight, leaving hundreds of miners facing
unemployment.

The iron originates from the slave-operated duergar foundries beneath the eastern mountains,
entering legitimate markets through the Blackwake Company's intermediaries.

Faction            Motivations and goals
Marquis Aldric     Protect Blackvein's economy, identify the source of the cheap metal, and
Voss               preserve his ability to meet royal tallage obligations.
Marquis Cedric     Encourage inexpensive imports and establish Westbridge as the
Bellamy            frontier's principal commercial center.
Blackwake          Expand its distribution network while concealing the provenance of its

Trust              trade.

Claimholders       productive mines supplying the merchants.
                   Divided between smiths benefiting from cheap materials and craftsmen
Emberhearth Kin

Potential progression: Falling mineral prices → mining bankruptcies → Ironmark foreclosures
→ labor unrest → investigations into fraudulent mining claims → diplomatic confrontation
between Voss and Bellamy.

This could become one of the principal economic conflicts of the campaign, with its sinister
origins remaining concealed for considerable time.

Established foundations: the duergar metal trade and the contrasting economic interests of
Blackvein and Westbridge.
